services.name: Horse Shows
services.desc: We take pride in the quality of our lesson horses. Most of our horses are retired show horses and have extensive training. Each horse was hand selected for our program, and we work hard to make sure each student is matched with the right horse. For more pictures, please click their names. HF Professor, or Professor for short, is an 19 year old Arabian gelding. Out of all our current lesson horses, Professor has been in our program the longest. He's one of our prized beginner lesson horses. Professor was shown for several years before coming to Ranchotel. Impulsive, a.k.a. Ace, is one of our newest Ranchotel lesson horses.
